qualification: The transaction POST route defaults a missing client date with new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], which uses UTC and can select the wrong local calendar day. The repository has no persisted user timezone, while the client already supplies transaction_date.
pass_rule: The UTC ISO fallback must be absent. The route must either require and directly use client-provided transaction_date, or derive a default through an explicit timezone-aware formatter. Existing insert, amount validation, category lookup and finalDate binding behavior must remain present. Exact winner replay must pass.
fallback: One frozen Claude Sonnet 5.5 call only after autonomous miss.
